observations: Photo 0: A large flat-screen TV displaying a bright blue ocean scene with three small boats. The screen has a thin bezel and is mounted on a stand with two legs. The background shows a marble-patterned surface and a yellow flower to the right.

Photo 1: The same TV showing a smart TV interface with app icons (BBC News, Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, etc.) and a 'New & Trending' section. The top right corner shows 'Samsung Smart TV' and 'HDTV' logos. The screen content is clear and colorful.
Photo 2: The TV displaying a scene from a movie or show with two girls in a hallway. The image is sharp and well-lit. The TV's stand and bezel are visible, consistent with the other photos.
All photos show the same TV from slightly different angles, with a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the screen.
No visible brand or model label on the TV frame or stand in any photo.
The screen appears to be functioning and displaying content clearly in all photos.

claims.claim: Top Notch 65" Samsung Crystal Clear Premium Uhd 4k Hdr Sleek Design Smart TV
claims.evidence: The screen shows 'Samsung Smart TV' logo in photo 1, supporting the brand claim. However, no model number or 'Crystal Clear Premium UHD 4K HDR' label is visible on the TV itself. The size is assumed from the seller's claim and screen proportions, but not confirmed by a visible measurement or bezel label.

risks.risk: The TV may not be a genuine Samsung or may be a refurbished/reconditioned unit with hidden defects.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV's back panel showing the brand, model number, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 65-inch smart TV, not as a premium Samsung model.

risks.risk: The TV may not support 4K UHD or HDR as claimed, or may have degraded performance due to age or use.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the TV playing a 4K HDR test pattern or a high-resolution movie, with visible color grading and detail.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard HD or Full HD smart TV, not as a premium 4K HDR model.

risks.risk: The TV may have physical damage not visible in the photos, such as dead pixels, screen burn-in, or cracked bezel.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen under uniform white or black background, and a full view of the TV's front and back.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential hidden defects.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the TV's back panel showing brand, model, and serial number.
Video clip of the TV playing a 4K HDR test pattern or high-resolution content.
Close-up photo of the screen under white and black backgrounds to check for dead pixels or burn-in.
Photo of the TV's stand and base to confirm condition and stability.
response.reason: The TV appears to be a large smart TV with a Samsung interface, but the brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos. The seller's claims about 4K UHD, HDR, and premium quality are unverified. Without proof of the model and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be evaluated further.
